reuse_envelope.reason: 317: evaluate reuse before custom construction without forcing it; compare total adaptation/revalidation cost and quality. Extend existing provenance with source/version/rights/dependencies, tested conditions, failures/evidence and measured-or-unknown effort. Run resource_manifest for the requested use; missing/stale evidence, untested conditions, unresolved rights or open failures block qualification. Assessed resources stay useful but unqualified. Manually verify applicability, rights and perceptual truth; a valid record is not an artistic pass. No new database, installation, spend or upload.

authority.reason: Confirm scope and genuine Director decisions. No new spend, installs, specialists, publication or protected creative changes by inference. Routine in-scope technical fixes remain agent-owned. Astra is top tier; failed method needs reassessment, not a nonexistent higher model.

strategy.reason: Read current strategy; name outcome, quality floor, interfaces, assumptions, earliest integrated proof, resources, reuse and replan/exit. Repeated compensating patches trigger method reassessment, not renamed passes.

visual_gate.reason: Compare the complete claimed result to accepted references and required use, seeking known and new failures plus adjacent regressions. Use explicit failing-shape controls before expensive integration; contact targets and material cannot substitute for the required silhouette. An occluded region is NOT_RUN until visibly inspected. Actual motion/audio where applicable; distinguish frame inspection from playback. Tests, better-than-before and source hashes do not establish perceptual PASS. Known FAIL/NOT_RUN blocks handoff.

anticipation.reason: Write audience intent and distraction hypotheses before a defect list. Test them against actual evidence, seek counterevidence and unlisted problems, record observations and corrections. Director feedback calibrates fallible judgment; it is not the primary defect detector.224: test opening hook, pacing and causal geography, not merely fit duration.248 adopts larger-than-life impact for The Martials and records it as a Director preference: name the extraordinary character-specific beat and its preparation/payoff; use contrast and believability, not constant maximum speed/loudness or unapproved powers. 249 requires a shot/beat performance and believability brief before execution: apply relevant expertise lenses, predict audience-visible anatomy/contact/physical-response failures, and bind each critical behavior to strategy, interfaces, early proof and observable failure conditions. Cover each beat or explicit inheritance; consult docs/planning/SHOT_BEAT_QUALITY_BRIEF.md. Roles are perspectives, not an org chart. Automatic brief completeness and perceptual judgment are not implemented.

stopping.reason: Meet the high quality floor first;248 clarifies efficiency means progressively more reliable and economical achievement of that bar, not lowering it. Then weigh visible benefit, dramatic value, reuse and regression/opportunity cost. Re-rank residuals after larger fixes. Prior tolerance is not acceptance. Record deferred details and reopening triggers; no arbitrary timer waives quality or creates handoff.

versioning.reason: Bind actual inputs, accepted scope, source hashes and dependencies. Revalidate affected checks after camera/motion/version changes. Preserve originals and failed evidence. A local commit is not native-media backup; a reopened scene is not proof of portable or general reuse.
